Only two phones from this page fit under ₹20,000 so I can't give you three yet. The iQOO Z11x 5G and Vivo T5x 5G both start at ₹18,999 (6GB + 128GB). Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
12:56 PM

National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. So it is open today, Thu 22 Oct, until 6:00 PM. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 enter free with an ID card. Source: the museum's own Plan Your Visit page. Online tickets are listed at zoonga.com/national-museum.
